items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: He used to call me the Mongolian because I have high cheekbones and stuff like that.

ctx.x: : He was a character, wasn't he?
Yeah, Wingy was something. He used to call me the Mongolian because I have high cheekbones and stuff like that.

So anyway, after Fletcher got sick, then I took the band over for the rest of the engagement. In fact, there's an album out now -- Fletcher Henderson in the '50s, and, of course, nobody knows who put it out, and I've taken it to the union --
